messages:
Iris: Running the prototype with a few beta customers. Two recurring confusions around routing order and the simulator behavior. Dropping notes here so we can pick quick wins.
Ben: Thanks  can you bullet the problems?
Iris: Top items: 1) People dont realize that list position drives execution; numeric precedence looks editable and conflicts with drag affordance. 2) When priorities collide we show a red 'invalid' chip with no guidance. 3) Simulator truncation differs from runtime which caused a false negative in one customer test. 4) Preview popover collapses if mouse jitters; users can't inspect long matches. 5) Keyboard users can't actuate the drag handle.
Alex: For #1 propose a small persistent label above the list: "Execution order (top to bottom)" + a tiny ? tooltip "Drag to reorder; edit precedence in Advanced mode". Keeps UI simple for new users and surfacing power mode.
Priya: Alternative: keep numbers visible but visually de-emphasize and add left-side position chips that mirror the list order. That maps visual position -> execution rank.
Ben: I like the "Advanced mode" toggle idea. Default = drag/edit order; Advanced unlocks numeric edits. Prevents accidental renumbering.
Iris: For collisions, replace terse "invalid" w/ actionable copy: "Priority collision  two rules share the same priority. Choose a different priority or click Auto-resolve." Add inline Auto-resolve CTA that renumbers deterministically and shows an Undo toast.
Alex: Good. Undo toast should include a changelog: "Auto-resolve moved Rule A to #3, Rule B to #4" and persist for ~8s. Also show a small changelist icon on affected rules.
Priya: Simulator fixes: make the popover sticky until ESC or explicit close. Add a pin control so users can keep it open while making edits. Also add microcopy under the preview: "Preview may differ from runtime on very long inputs."
Ben: On tokenizer parity: short-term microcopy + ticket to call the same runtime tokenizer. Long-term we should use the runtime preview endpoint for exact parity. I'll tag eng-runtime.
Iris: Keyboard accessibility: add focusable reorder control (aria-roledescription="reorder handle") and support Cmd/Ctrl+Up / Cmd/Ctrl+Down to move a focused row. Surface keyboard hint on row focus.
Alex: A11y nit: simulator result container should be aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic="true"; when pinned, trap focus and set role="dialog". Also announce Auto-resolve completion via non-modal toast.
qa_bot: Created TKT-9922: "Routing editor  execution-order hint, Auto-resolve UX, simulator stickiness, and keyboard reorder"  assignees: Ben, Priya; priority: P2; due: 2024-07-18.
Iris: Can design ship two comps (default + Advanced mode) showing focus styles, keyboard hints, Auto-resolve flow, and pinned simulator by tomorrow afternoon?
Ben: Yes  I'll split TKT-9922 into three sub-tasks and add the tokenizer-parity ticket. Will post RFC link when ready.
Priya: Thanks  I'll include copy variations for the collision message and the preview microcopy in the ticket.
